subject: [PATCH v5 6/7] mm: use BIT() for change_protection() flags

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Applied his Reviewed-by tag without providing any feedback or comments.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the handling of change protection flags in the Linux kernel by using the BIT() macro consistently throughout the code. The current implementation uses open-coded shifts, which can be error-prone and difficult to maintain. By switching to BIT(), the code becomes more readable and easier to understand.
